name: Zarapicos (Spain)
description: Square blue flag with a yellow band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Zarapicos (a cross on red and birds on green).
history: Municipal flag of Zarapicos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
